description: This Java source file defines a final class CreateThingSubstitutionStrategy that handles substitution logic for CreateThing commands, particularly for ACLs and policies, within the Eclipse Ditto project. It performs JSON policy parsing, substitution, and manages related data structures.

classes.name: CreateThingSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: Handles substitution logic for CreateThing commands, particularly for policies and headers, ensuring proper JSON parsing and object replacement when needed.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs substitution on the provided CreateThing command using the specified substitution algorithm, returning a new WithDittoHeaders instance with substituted data if changes occurred.

methods.name: substituteInitialPolicy
methods.description: Attempts to parse and substitute policies within a JSON object representing an initial policy, with debug logging on parse failure.
